captions.detailed: A folding steel security bollard with a dark grey cylindrical post and a black base plate. The vertical post has a rounded dome top, two light-grey reflective bands wrapped around its body, and is attached to a heavy-duty hinge at the base. The black base plate contains mounting bolts and upright brackets that hold the hinge pin, allowing the bollard to fold down 90 degrees to a horizontal position. A vertical steel flange with a circular hole is attached to the base, serving as a padlock receiver to lock the bollard in its upright position.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a folding security bollard. The assembly must feature a black rectangular base plate with mounting bolt heads, upright hinge brackets, and a padlock locking tab. A cylindrical dark grey post with a domed cap and two light-grey reflective stripes should connect to the base plate via a revolute joint, allowing it to pivot from a vertical standing position to a flat horizontal position.
captions.factory: Construct a base plate using a Box primitive, and add four small Cylinders to represent mounting bolts. Model the upright hinge brackets and the padlock receiver tab using Box primitives with boolean operations to create holes. Construct the folding bollard post using a Cylinder primitive, capping it with a Sphere primitive at the top. Create the reflective bands by overlaying thin, slightly larger-diameter Cylinders. Define a revolute articulation joint between the base plate and the post assembly, setting its axis horizontally through the hinge pin location.
